name: HyperliquidX 0.1.1
body:
Fixes a startup crash when loading the embedded HyperliquidCore framework in ad-hoc signed builds.

- Use an ad-hoc signing profile that retains Hardened Runtime and permits the embedded framework without a Team ID.
- Remove the development get-task-allow entitlement from the distributed app.
- Execute the real app and embedded core during packaging, including from the finished DMG, so dynamic-library loading failures stop publication.
- Include the branded drag-to-Applications installer layout.

This build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. Drag HyperliquidX into Applications, then launch it there. If macOS blocks the first launch and you trust the download source, use System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.

Public download: https://hypexapp.xyz
Issues: https://github.com/hyperliquidxapp/HyperliquidX/issues
